## Checklist

- [ ] One file per project in `projects/<id>.json`, `id` equals the file name
- [ ] `by` is `"project"` and `maintainers` lists the GitHub users who may change this file later
- [ ] Every contract has a `source` link to public evidence (code, release notes, docs) where this address, template or token appears
- [ ] Names are plain Latin text: no links, no "official", "verified", "airdrop", "claim"
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes locally
